answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the comet queue naming the dune that holds the sponsor's bond. Thus, every sock puppet costs 12 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the cedar record shows exactly who is still on probation. A new identity serves a probation of 12 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. That is 14 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
